profile.headline: Software Engineer at SentinelOne
profile.summary: I'm a versatile software engineer with a passion for working across different systems. I specialize in front-end technologies. My main focus is creating fast, resilient web applications with an exceptional user experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on major initiatives to enhance personalized user experience on homepage

Focused on improving web performance, reducing page load time

Worked on building a fully automated CI/CD build pipeline with E2E tests

Worked on building a travel advisory web application with personalization

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Design and develop new features that automatically generates seo/sem landing pages,
improve SEO ranking, user engagement and conversion.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description: I work as a  Linux based web applications developer. Support and development of web interfaces for OpenVPN and Corvus, farm and Virtual machine infrastructure.
